meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: This skill automates version bumping during the release process for the Claude Code Handbook monorepo. It should be used when the user requests to bump versions, prepare a release, or increment version numbers across the repository.

copy.tagline: 自动递增版本号，简化发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化 Monorepo 的版本发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate version increment for smoother releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate version bumping in a monorepo release process

howto.what: 当用户要求提升版本时，Claude 会先列出当前各插件的版本，询问要提升哪些插件以及提升类型（major/minor/patch），然后运行脚本更新版本，最后报告每个插件的旧版本和新版本。
howto.when: 当用户提到“bump version”、“increment version”或“update version numbers”，或者涉及“major”、“minor”、“patch”版本变化时触发。

say.text: 把 handbook-dotnet 插件的版本号提升一个小版本。
say.note: Claude 会先查询当前版本并确认提升类型。

say.text: 将所有插件的版本号提升一个补丁版本。
say.note: Claude 会使用 --all 参数一次性更新所有插件。

howto.what_en: When the user requests a version bump, Claude lists current plugin versions, asks which plugins and bump type (major/minor/patch), runs the update script, then reports old and new versions per plugin.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "bump version", "increment version", "update version numbers", or references "major", "minor", "patch" version changes.

say_en.text: Bump the handbook-dotnet plugin to a new minor version.
say_en.note: Claude will check current version and ask for bump type.

say_en.text: Bump all plugins to a new patch version.
say_en.note: Claude will use --all to update every plugin.
